detail.longDescription: I came up just now with a new way to implement reversible assignment as in Icon. The current implementation puts ‘undo’ records on the execution stack. These get used during unwinding. The records contain addresses of variables. My new method makes every storage cell potentially a stack. In other words, reversible assignment is a particular use of dynamic assignment in the Lisp sense. This method is both simpler and more general. # programming # programmingLanguages # Icon # Lisp # Scheme
